name: Magic Shoppe, Back Room
desc1: The first thing that you notice as you enter this room is a striking
desc2: middle-aged woman, wearing deep purple robes embroidered with silver
desc3: runes. As you take a closer look, you can see pointed ears protruding
desc4: from her long silvery hair -- she is an Elf! As you approach, she nods
desc5: and gestures for you to sit down, saying "Welcome, adventurers. Do ye
desc6: need training in the magical arts?"
